correctness.rationale: The smoothness proof uses simple roots of f_d and at Z=0 the d distinct points Y/X being dth roots of unity. Exact ternary Hessian factor is d(d−1)^2 Y^{d−2}G_d^hom. The recurrence f_{d+1}=x f_d−f_{d−1} gives degree(G)=2d−4 with leading coefficient −2d². For real x, the f-root reciprocal identity G/f²=−Σ_{i<j}((x−alpha_i)^{-1}−(x−alpha_j)^{-1})²<0, with G(alpha_i)=−(d−1)f"(alpha_i)^2<0. Squarefreeness follows from G=G′=0 plus the Chebyshev ODE, yielding af′=df then contradiction 4 f′²=0. At f-roots, tangent x=alpha has contact d and Hessian multiplicity d−2; every simple root of G supports d ordinary flexes; infinity points have Ghom and Y nonzero. Independent exact symbolic computations verified recurrence, ODE, leading term and squarefree/coprime G for d=4..12. These finite calculations corroborate but cannot replace universal proof.

final_claim: For every d>=4, smooth plane Chebyshev curve y^d=2T_d(x/2) over C has exactly d real hyperflexes of tangent contact d at the real roots of f_d and 2d(d−2) ordinary nonreal flexes lying over the simple nonreal roots of G_d=d f_d f_d"−(d−1)(f_d")². The full complex flex count is d(2d−3), total weighted divisor 3d(d−2), with no flex at infinity.
